subject: Evaluation kickoff  trial plan & success criteria
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam Carter <liam.carter@acme.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation kickoff - trial plan & success criteria

Hi Liam,

Thanks again for taking the time today - great to learn more about Acme's plan for integrating a model-powered assistant into your internal support workflows. Quick recap and proposed next step: an evaluation kickoff where we run a short trial (2-4 weeks) and align on success criteria and prompt sets.

Recap from today's discovery:
- Goal: deploy an assistant to triage incoming tickets and draft suggested responses; target latency < 600ms 95th pct for 4k context.
- Key constraints: PII redaction, on-prem/private enclave for logs, SOC2 evidence required.
- Volume: ~80 reqs/min during peak; heavy tail of long historical context for some tickets.

Proposed evaluation kickoff (technical deep dive + trial plan):
- Objectives: review trial scope, finalize success criteria, collect initial prompt set and test cases, confirm security/hosting needs.
- Duration: 60 min (technical deep dive + ops plan)
- Proposed times (PT):
  * Tue Oct 6 - 10:00-11:00 PT
  * Wed Oct 7 - 14:00-15:00 PT
  * Thu Oct 8 - 09:00-10:00 PT

Attendees we suggest: you (product), Priya (engineering/infra), Connor Obrien (SE, I cc'd), me. Please let me know which slot works or share alternative availability. Also can you confirm the technical contact who will own the trial setup (VPN/VPC, KMS, etc.)?

I've attached a short trial plan and our security eval checklist to make it easier to scope the kickoff. If you can share a sample prompt set or a few representative tickets ahead of the call that would speed things up.

Attachments:
- redwood-trial-plan.pdf (PDF, 6 pages)
- security-eval-checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 12 rows)

Thanks - looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
